name: R3; Solana Foundation
summary: Collaboration to connect Corda/private networks with Solana. Potential institutional interoperability.
limit: Corda assets and banks are not automatically migrated.

name: J.P. Morgan; Galaxy; Coinbase; Franklin Templeton
summary: Galaxy commercial paper issuance arranged on Solana, with USDC delivery-versus-payment. Shows coordinated asset and payment settlement.
limit: One transaction does not establish recurring volume.

name: Visa; Cross River Bank; Lead Bank
summary: Initial U.S. banks began USDC settlement with Visa on Solana. Back-end settlement can change without changing consumer cards.
limit: Later Visa aggregate volume is multichain, not Solana-only.

name: WisdomTree
summary: Expanded tokenized-fund ecosystem to Solana. Adds regulated investment products to the network.
limit: Multichain distribution; product eligibility and rights apply.

name: Solana Foundation; Mastercard; Worldpay; Western Union
summary: Launched SDP issuance and payments modules with over 20 infrastructure partners in devnet sandbox. Packages infrastructure for enterprise developers.
limit: Sandbox module launch is not production adoption by every named user; trading planned later.

name: Singapore Gulf Bank
summary: Introduced bank-account-integrated USDC mint/redeem for corporate and HNW customers. Connects bank treasury and stablecoins.
limit: Multichain; above $100,000 launch threshold; fee promotion temporary.

name: Western Union; Anchorage Digital Bank
summary: Launched USDPT on Solana with Anchorage as issuer. Creates a settlement asset for developing payment workflows.
limit: Does not mean all Western Union remittances moved onchain.

name: Mastercard
summary: Expanded settlement plans include stablecoins across eight named networks including Solana. Institutions get more settlement timing and asset options.
limit: Early USDC flows in select markets; broader rollout planned; no Solana-specific volume.

name: Mastercard; Solana Foundation; other participants
summary: Introduced Agent Pay for Machines with credentialing, permissioning and multirail settlement. Targets machine-speed authorized payments.
limit: Participation and launch do not establish large paid usage.

name: MoneyGram; Solana Foundation
summary: MoneyGram joined SDP as infrastructure partner and became active Solana validator. Institution also operates network infrastructure.
limit: Validator operation is distinct from customer payment volume.

name: Linux Foundation; Coinbase; Solana Foundation; other members
summary: x402 Foundation became operational under open governance. Standardizes HTTP payment infrastructure.
limit: Governance launch, not proof of mass agent purchases; multichain standard.

name: MoneyGram; Solana Foundation; Rift
summary: Ramps API launched on Solana with cash deposits in 25+ countries and withdrawals in 170+ countries and territories. Connects wallets to physical cash distribution.
limit: Supported geography is availability, not adoption or universal location coverage.

name: Coinbase AM · Superstate
summary: CUSHY tokenized stablecoin yield-fund share class added to Solana in July.
limit: Qualified purchasers only. DeFi integrations described as coming soon; not instant redemption.

name: Solana Foundation · Google Cloud
summary: Pay.sh coordinates discovery and pay-per-request API access using x402 and MPP.
limit: Payment access does not verify whether the returned work is correct.
